review_evidence: README describes GOOSE as a Lean specification with a surface object language, AVM object model and Anoma Resource Machine structures, rather than merely an executable client.

The 86 primary files contain 758 declaration-style items and 22 theorem/lemma/example declarations; formal data/model layers encode the object-language and machine structures while examples exercise the specified language.
The project provides an independent formal specification/semantics interface, which qualifies as prior art even where many declarations are executable definitions.
summary: Reviewed goose-lean and retain its Lean specification of the GOOSE object language, AVM model and Anoma resource-machine structures.
